initial.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production 2D game battle animation sprite atlas. Use the input image as the character identity, clothing, materials and weapon design reference. Create ONE transparent PNG landscape atlas, exactly 1536 x 1024 pixels, exactly 3 columns and 2 rows, each invisible grid cell 512 x 512 pixels. Exactly SIX full-body drawings of the SAME character, one in each cell. No visible grid, borders, numbering, text, shadows on a floor, background, other characters, projectiles, lasers, glow VFX or motion trails. Genuine transparent alpha around the silhouette. Keep the original dark fantasy anime illustration style and costume details at readable game-sprite detail, NOT chibi.
CRITICAL registration: same body scale in every cell, approximately 360 px standing body height; feet contact the common local y=470 baseline (92% down each cell); local body root x=256. Keep every weapon tip, hair strand, coat and foot inside its own 512-square cell with at least 22 px padding on all sides, and leave at least 20 transparent pixels around all cell borders. Never let one drawing overlap another cell. Use a consistent orthographic side-on/three-quarter battle camera, never camera zoom. The body may lean naturally but the feet stay registered; change actual arms, legs, torso and weapon angles between poses. A single repeated portrait translated/rotated is unacceptable. Clean discrete animation key poses, not six unrelated illustrations.
Reading order: top row cell0 combat idle, cell1 windup, cell2 committed weapon swing immediately before contact; bottom row cell3 contact/followthrough, cell4 recovery, cell5 hit recoil. Draw only one pose per cell with no ghost/duplicate limbs. Character: Lian, the reference's young silver bob-haired knight, asymmetric pale blue and amber eyes, black fitted clothing and boots, long torn white/navy coat, fine gold trim/crosses, articulated armor, ornate oval circular layered steel/gold shield, straight steel sword with gold hilt (the sword seen sheathed in reference must now be drawn). Preserve face, hairstyle, outfit, sword and shield identity.
All six poses face SCREEN RIGHT, attack target is to the right. Hold sword in anatomical right hand and shield in anatomical left hand consistently; shield is strapped and remains visible. Pose0: bent-knee guarded battle idle, drawn sword pointed down-right, shield ready. Pose1: right sword arm clearly drawn back high behind head, torso twists back, left shield forward. Pose2: strong stepping sword slash toward right, right arm extended, torso twists forward, rear heel lifted; long steel blade fully visible reaches right side of cell at local x~475,y~235. Pose3: sword completes diagonal downward slash forward-right, deep planted lunge, shield tucked slightly aside, weapon tip x~475,y~300. Pose4: gathers sword and shield back into guarded stance, coat settling. Pose5: recoils from a hit arriving from right, upper body arches back to left, shield knocked up, knees buckle but feet remain near baseline. Clearly readable joints and heavy planted movement. Keep action sober and physical, no glowing blades, magic or laser effects.
